description: S1 host_os: spawn keyword policy (POSIX and the Windows creation flags by value), the Python stdio channel, run_process results/input/timeout, observed spawns and a refusing observer killing its child, logged children with timeout cleanup and stray descendants, ProcessTree boundary and two-part termination receipts, scratch removal with read-only leftovers and an outside symlink, and pure diagnostics (publication, narrow, service-entry argument and exit facts, journal scalars). OS pids and group ids are projected out
